# Opal Pettigrew

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c36 P23](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0023), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>

## Appearance

Opal is a striking and handsome young woman with a full, eye-catching figure, radiant skin, and big, vivid blue eyes. She has long, bright blonde hair and a fair complexion. When in town, she wears her skirts as long as permitted and styles her hair up, though she wears it down when at home.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c28 P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Opal possesses a sunny, cheerful disposition, enjoying laughter and the pleasant aspects of life. She is sentimental and highly interested in romance, suitors, and male attention. Under fright or emotional stress, she is prone to fits of hysterics and weeping. Her conversation frequently revolves around young men and compliments she receives.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c26 P6](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0006), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c28 P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v2 c26 P58](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0058), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_

## Goals

- to possess numerous suitors and enjoy a gay time before settling down  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)</sub>
- to get a boyfriend upon turning fifteen  <sub>[v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005)</sub>
- to teach for two years before marrying  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Opal attended Brierley school alongside Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke. During her school years, she joined the student tale-writing society, contributed to school concerts, and participated in outdoor games such as re-enacting the story of Elaine. She subsequently entered the Regent's entrance class and passed her exams to attend Regent's Academy in Port Marlow. While studying at Regent's, she frequently walked home with Hugh Carrow and focused her efforts on securing her teaching qualifications. After successfully passing her teacher's examinations, Opal was hired to teach at the Delford school, returning home to Brierley on weekends. During her time teaching at Delford, she received a romantic proposal from Nelson Atkins, which she rejected after discovering he had copied it from an etiquette book.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c28 P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P35](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0035), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 c36 P23](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0023), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v2 c26 P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056)_
